finding.claim: For negative numbers argument.toString(2/8/16) returns a string with leading '-', so '0x'+hex, '0b'+bin and '0o'+oct produce invalid literals like '0x-A' and '0b-101' instead of '-0xA' and '-0b101'.
finding.title: Negative numbers with hexadecimal/binary/octal produce invalid literals

verifier.reason: The code at jsesc.js:217-225 directly prefixes '0x'/'0b'/'0o' to argument.toString(16/2/8) with no sign handling, so a negative value whose toString yields a leading '-' produces invalid literals like '0x-A'.
